[LTES.5.1] An event trace is the canonical input a test drives the engine
with. What a test authors is the **inject-class** part of one — a time-ordered
sequence of fact assertions, retractions, clock advances and adapter events
([RFCS.17.1]). The compare-class events are what the engine emits in response
([LFST.1.3]), and what the test then checks.
